title: Ashen Arena(web game) pvp/pve style arena fighter
author: Individual-Quail-889
selftext:
Game Title: Ashen Arena

Playable Link: [https://momojojogames.itch.io/ashen-arena](https://momojojogames.itch.io/ashen-arena)

Platform: PC and Mobile (Web only, landscape on phone)

Description:

I grew up on chaotic browser games and dungeon crawlers, and I always wanted one that did both. So I made it. You dress up a little chibi fighter, loot like crazy, then either throw down in an arena or team up and go into a dungeon together.

How it works:

You get 60 seconds to loot the grounds, level up and grab the best gear you can find.

Then everyone gets pulled into the arena. Last one standing wins.

Or skip the PvP and go below with up to 3 friends (or bots): clear a dungeon room by room, pick your path at the forks, and take down the boss at the bottom. There are 10 dungeons, each with its own boss and something hidden for people who look around.

Combat is all about timing. Parry the wind-up, roll through the hit at the last second, then punish. Once it clicks, it feels so good.

Then you unlock new looks, hop back in, and do it all again.

Free to Play Status: Free to play. No ads, no sign-up, nothing to download.

Involvement: Solo dev, work as a software engineer and did a few game dev stuff on the side for fun so decided to see what new in the scene and just work on something. I did the design, the game and the late nights with testing and iterating on ideas.

Side note: it's in alpha, so there will be bugs. The online server naps when nobody's on, so your first online match might take up to a minute to connect (offline modes start instantly). Bots fill empty seats and are tagged so you know who's real. I'll be online anytime if you want to fight an actual person or coop

I'd appreciate the feedback: what felt fun, what felt off, and whether the first match made sense without the tutorial. Every comment helps and leave your games here so i can check them out too. Thank you for playing!
